name: Cłapa Floor Master Typ 130 (cable powered)
summary: Remote-controlled floor robot from Poland that spreads, compacts and levels cement-sand screed and concrete with laser levelling to ±1 mm per 20 m. The cable version runs on mains power without a charge limit.

germany.statusNote: Direct from the Polish maker (Wieruszów); the page offers "Zapytaj o ofertę" (ask for a quote) and shows no price.

sellers.note: Sold directly by the maker, no intermediaries per its page; price on request.
sellers.name: Cłapa (Floor Master)

specs.label: Power supply (cable version)
specs.value: 110–230 V AC mains, 24 V DC working voltage

notes: Remote-control operation; the operator stands next to the machine.
Maker says it may be used outdoors only with suitable protection of the electronics.
Drive type is not stated on the page read; wheels are assumed because the gallery shows it driving through doors.
